about: NDBs HEARD on VibeSDR receivers, identified by ear and by the skimmer, that no bundled source lists. Each record is our own reception: the ident and the frequency as measured; the position is the named airport's reference point from OurAirports airports.csv (public domain) — a locator sits on the approach, a few km from it. Lowest position precedence: any public source that lists the beacon wins. Add only beacons heard for hours, on more than one receiver or day. A beacon another source lists WITHOUT a name (OSM's NWI, KIM) may be here too: the other source keeps its position and this file supplies the name. Each record added from 2026-11-04 also carries "identified": how we know WHICH beacon carries that ident on that frequency — "confirmed" (two independent sources tie the ident and frequency to the place) or "likely" (one clear source), with the URLs. Those sources are used ONLY to identify the beacon: nothing is copied from them, and the position is still the airport's from OurAirports.
